{{Short description|Solid made from 2 cupolae joined base-to-base}}

In [[geometry]], a '''bicupola''' is a solid formed by connecting two [[cupola (geometry)|cupolae]] on their bases. Here, two classes of bicupola are included because each cupola (bicupola half) is bordered by alternating triangles and squares. If similar faces are attached together the result is an ''orthobicupola''; if squares are attached to triangles it is a ''gyrobicupola''.

==Forms==
In the first column of the two following tables, the symbols are Schoenflies, Coxeter, and orbifold notation, in this order.

|-

|[[Square orthobicupola]] ({{math|''J''{{sub|28}}}}): 8 triangles, 10 squares.{{r|berman}}
|-

|[[Image:Pentagonal orthobicupola.png|100px]]
|[[Pentagonal orthobicupola]] ({{math|''J''{{sub|30}}}}): 10 triangles, 10 squares, 2 pentagons.{{r|berman}}

===Set of gyrobicupolae===
An {{mvar|n}}-gonal gyrobicupola has the same topology as an {{mvar|n}}-gonal rectified antiprism, [[Conway polyhedron notation]]: {{math|aA''n''}}.{{clarify|reason=The symbol aAn cannot be found in the linked article.|date=December 2025}}
{|class="wikitable"
![[List of spherical symmetry groups|Symmetry]]
!Picture
!Description
|-
!{{math|D{{sub|2d}}<BR>[2{{sup|+}},4]<BR>2*2}}
|[[Image:Gyrobifastigium.png|100px]]
|[[Gyrobifastigium]] ({{math|''J''{{sub|26}}}}) or ''digonal gyrobicupola'': 4 triangles, 4 squares.{{r|Johnson}}
|-
!{{math|D{{sub|3d}}<BR>[2{{sup|+}},6]<BR>2*3}}
|[[File:Cuboctahedron.png|100px]]
|''Triangular gyrobicupola'' or [[cuboctahedron]]: 8 triangles, 6 squares.{{r|os|berman}} Its dual is the [[rhombic dodecahedron]].
|-
!{{math|D{{sub|4d}}<BR>[2{{sup|+}},8]<BR>2*4}}
|[[Image:Square gyrobicupola.png|100px]]
|[[Square gyrobicupola]] ({{math|''J''{{sub|29}}}}): 8 triangles, 10 squares.{{r|berman}} Its dual is the elongated [[tetragonal trapezohedron]]
|-
!{{math|D{{sub|5d}}<BR>[2{{sup|+}},10]<BR>2*5}}
|[[Image:Pentagonal gyrobicupola.png|100px]]
|[[Pentagonal gyrobicupola]] ({{math|''J''{{sub|31}}}}): 10 triangles, 10 squares, 2 pentagons.{{r|berman}} Its dual is the elongated [[pentagonal trapezohedron]]
|-
!{{math|D{{sub|''n''d}}<BR>[2{{sup|+}},2''n'']<BR>2*''n''}}
|
|{{nowrap|{{mvar|n}}-gonal}} gyrobicupola: {{math|2''n''}} triangles, {{math|2''n''}} rectangles, 2 {{nowrap|{{mvar|n}}-gons}}.
|}
